effect_description_eng:
[Security] [Opponent's Turn] All of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 2 or less. For each of your face-up security cards, add 2 to this effect's maximum play cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
